umbrella_agency.quote: "Licensing agency" means the Indiana professional licensing agency established by IC 25-1-5-3 .

degree_required.value: Graduation in an approved engineering curriculum of four (4) years or more
degree_required.quote: Graduation in an approved engineering curriculum of four (4) years or more.

accrediting_body.value: Engineering Accreditation Commission of the Accreditation Board for Engineering and Technology
accrediting_body.quote: the board may take into consideration the standards of accreditation adopted by the Engineering Accreditation Commission of the Accreditation Board for Engineering and Technology.

degree_level.quote: Graduation in an approved engineering curriculum of four (4) years or more.

school_approval_basis.quote: "Approved engineering curriculum" means an engineering curriculum of four (4) years or more that has been approved by the board.

credential_pegged.quote: Graduation in an approved engineering curriculum of four (4) years or more.

required.quote: A specific record of four (4) years or more of progressive experience on engineering projects of sufficient quality acquired subsequent to graduation

experience_source.quote: A specific record of four (4) years or more of progressive experience on engineering projects of sufficient quality acquired subsequent to graduation

duration.quote: A specific record of four (4) years or more of progressive experience on engineering projects of sufficient quality acquired subsequent to graduation

kind.quote: progressive experience on engineering projects of sufficient quality acquired subsequent to graduation, which experience indicates that the applicant is qualified to be placed in responsible charge of engineering work

exams.name: Engineering Fundamentals
exams.notes: First part of the two-part examination; tests knowledge of mathematics and physical and engineering sciences. Applicants with an engineering intern certificate may be exempted from this portion.
exams.quote: The examination required of all applicants for registration as a professional engineer shall be a written or computer based examination which shall be divided into the following two (2) parts: (1) Engineering fundamentals.

exams.name: Principles and Practice of Engineering
exams.notes: Second part of the two-part examination; tests understanding and judgment in applying engineering principles. Must pass Engineering Fundamentals before taking this part.
exams.quote: The examination required of all applicants for registration as a professional engineer shall be a written or computer based examination which shall be divided into the following two (2) parts: ... (2) Principles and practice of engineering.

interval_years.quote: unless renewed, a certificate issued under this chapter expires on a date specified by the licensing agency under IC 25-1-6-4 and expires biennially after the initial expiration date.

required.quote: The board may adopt rules requiring a professional engineer to obtain continuing education for renewal of a certificate under section 17 of this chapter.

available.quote: The board may, upon application and payment of a fee established by the board in the board's rules, issue a certificate of registration as a professional engineer to an individual who holds a valid certificate of registration as a professional engineer, issued to the applicant by the proper authority of any state or territory or possession of the United States

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a valid PE certificate from another state/territory/possession of the US with requirements not conflicting with Indiana's chapter. Board may accept verified professional record certified by the National Council of Examiners for Engineers and Surveyors (NCEES). Reduced experience requirement (3 years post-graduation) applies if applicant has been registered in another state for at least 10 years.
requirements.quote: the board may accept the verified professional record of the applicant that is certified by the National Council of Examiners for Engineers and Surveyors.

exists.quote: The state board of registration for professional engineers is created.

regulatory_model.quote: practices or offers to practice engineering without being registered or exempted under the laws of this state

credential_type.quote: The board shall issue a certificate of registration ... to any applicant who, in the opinion of the board, has satisfactorily met all requirements of this chapter. In the case of a professional engineer, the certificate shall authorize the practice of "professional engineering".

is_mandatory.quote: practices or offers to practice engineering without being registered or exempted under the laws of this state

title_protection.quote: an architect who is registered under IC 25-4-1 and exempted from this chapter may not use the designation "engineer" in any form or manner unless the architect is registered under this chapter.

approximate.matched_normalized: who is registered under ic 25 4 1 and exempted from this chapter may not use the designation engineer in any form or manner unless the architect is registered under this chapter

scope_protection.quote: A person who: (1) practices or offers to practice engineering without being registered or exempted under the laws of this state ... commits a Class B misdemeanor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or offering to practice engineering without being registered or exempted under Indiana law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practices or offers to practice engineering without being registered or exempted under the laws of this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Presenting as one's own the certificate of registration or seal of another person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: presents as the person's own the certificate of registration or the seal of another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Giving false or forged evidence to the board or any member of the board to obtain a certificate of registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: gives any false or forged evidence of any kind to the board or to any member of the board in obtaining a certificate of registration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using an expired, suspended, or revoked certificate of registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: uses an expired, suspended, or revoked certificate of registration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making a false statement in the application for registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person who knowingly makes a false statement in the application commits a Class A misdemeanor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Stamping or sealing any document with a seal after the certificate of the registrant named on the seal has expired or been revoked
disciplinary_grounds.quote: It is unlawful for any person to stamp or seal any document with a seal after the certificate of the registrant named on the seal has expired or has been revoked.

definition_quote.value: any service or creative work that the adequate performance of requires engineering education, training, and experience in the application of special knowledge of the mathematical, physical, and engineering sciences to services or creative work that includes consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning, design of or supervision of design of engineering works and systems, engineering surveys and studies, and evaluation of construction for compliance with specifications
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of engineering" means any service or creative work that the adequate performance of requires engineering education, training, and experience in the application of special knowledge of the mathematical, physical, and engineering sciences to services or creative work

value: Planning, including planning the use of land and water
Design of or supervision of design of engineering works and systems
Evaluation of construction for compliance with specifications, plans, and designs
methods_authorized.quote: services or creative work that includes the following: (1) Consultation. (2) Investigation. (3) Evaluation. (4) Planning, including planning the use of land and water. (5) The design of or the supervision of the design of engineering works and systems. (6) Engineering surveys and studies ... (7) Evaluation of construction for the purpose of assuring compliance with specifications, plans, and designs

covers_land_surveying.quote: not including the surveying of real property for the establishment of land boundaries, subdivisions, rights-of-way, easements, and the dependent or independent surveys or resurveys of the public land survey system.

engineer_intern_certificate_available.quote: "Engineering intern" means an individual who ... has been issued by the board an appropriate certificate of enrollment as an engineering intern.

postgraduate_degree_experience_credit_ye.quote: An applicant who holds a degree of doctor of philosophy or the equivalent thereof from a curriculum in engineering approved by the board may be given a maximum of credit of two (2) years of experience in addition to a credit of four (4) years of education.

responsible_charge_defined.quote: have been in responsible charge of engineering work or engineering teaching for at least five (5) years.

seal_required_on_documents.quote: During the period of time that a registrant's certificate is valid, the registrant is authorized to apply the registrant's seal to plans, specifications, studies, drawings, and reports.

seal_document_types.quote: the registrant is authorized to apply the registrant's seal to plans, specifications, studies, drawings, and reports.

firm_practice_allowed.quote: A business, including a proprietorship, partnership, or corporation, doing business in Indiana may not practice or offer to practice engineering unless that practice is carried on under the responsible direction and supervision of a registered professional engineer who is a full-time employee of the business.

value: Employee or subordinate of a registered PE whose practice does not include responsible charge of design or supervision
Engineering on property owned or leased by the individual/business (unless involving public health/safety or employee health/safety)
Engineering relating solely to the design or fabrication of manufactured products
Landscape architect registered under IC 25-4-2 while engaged in practice of landscape architecture planning the use of land or water
exemptions_from_licensure.quote: An employee or a subordinate of any person who holds a certificate of registration under the provisions of this chapter is exempt from the provisions of this chapter if the practice of the employee or subordinate does not include responsible charge of design or supervision.

board_member_responsible_charge_years_re.quote: have been in responsible charge of engineering work or engineering teaching for at least five (5) years.
